plan.title: Replace inline uv run python -c helpers in consumer task files

narratives.Description: Several consumer-visible task files (change.yml, commit.yml, framework.yml, install.yml setup paths) still embed uv run python -c one-liners for path checks and guards. This story replaces those with portable shell, node one-liners, or dedicated TS verbs so the consumer task graph has no inline Python.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
Inventory tasks/change.yml, tasks/commit.yml, tasks/framework.yml, and related files for uv run python -c blocks on the consumer path.
Replace each with TS verb, node -e, or go-task-native sh blocks that preserve behavior (especially #1011 UV_PROJECT and #566 path semantics on Windows).
Add regression coverage via verify:no-task-runtime and targeted task tests.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer on Windows or Linux, I want task guards to run without embedded Python one-liners, so that task works on machines with no Python installed.
